# Network360 Core Team

With this release, the Network360 Core Team is excited to add enhancements to Competitive Dashboard for users to determine their network’s competitiveness based on provider or provider location attributes.   

## Enhancements

#### Competitive Dashboard

Users can now select provider or provider location attributes as part of their analysis criteria by clicking on the expandable “Show attribute options.”  

 Then the attribute selection fields will appear.  First, the user will select their desired attribute category (e.g., access, cost, quality, etc.)  The available attributes associated with that category will display, and the user can select their desired specific criteria.  (Note: the available attributes will depend on the attributes contained within the selected project’s data.) 

The user’s attribute selection will be applied to all Competitive Dashboard results and exports. 

## Fixes

#### Accessibility

Now, headers display at the top of the pages within the pdf consistently instead of page breaks occurring sometimes in the middle of a chart.

Fixed an issue where a blank page appeared below the Analysis Criteria page in the pdf export.

Now, clients’ permissions to view tags and recruitment are appropriately applied within the Accessibility module.  

#### Create a List

Now, the provider count is consistent in the Summary and Detail Results when the user selects both high and low specialty confidence levels as the criteria.

Fixed an error that occurred when the user selected a datetime custom attribute as part of the analysis criteria. The error no longer occurs. 

#### Provider List

Now, users can easily remove provider location tags in a similar process as the removal of provider tags.
